# Plugin part reference

Generated from the part prop schemas and metadata in Contracts. Each page documents serialized props, accepted Slots, accessibility behavior, appearance, events, and version notes.

The reference catalog includes shipped wire parts and Plugin-tier contracts recorded in the kit catalog. Pages are generated from Contracts schemas and metadata; they do not imply that a part is already available in every App version.

| Part | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`ActionList`](./ActionList.md) | Actions offered by a page, row, or tile. |
| [`Alert`](./Alert.md) | A confirmation overlay opened through an Action. |
| [`Audio`](./Audio.md) | Audio with an Argo transport row, scrubber, and elapsed time. |
| [`Avatar`](./Avatar.md) | An image or initials with a size and optional status mark. |
| [`Button`](./Button.md) | An actionable control with Argo variants, sizes, and an optional activation handler. |
| [`ButtonGroup`](./ButtonGroup.md) | A horizontal or vertical group of buttons. |
| [`Callout`](./Callout.md) | A title, description, and one primary action. |
| [`Card`](./Card.md) | A composed card with fixed media, title, subtitle, body, and action Slots. |
| [`Chart`](./Chart.md) | A bounded data visualization. |
| [`Checkbox`](./Checkbox.md) | A labeled binary or mixed selection control. |
| [`Code`](./Code.md) | A monospaced code block with a copy action. |
| [`CodeMap`](./CodeMap.md) | A bounded code map visual. |
| [`Collapsible`](./Collapsible.md) | A disclosure container that shows or hides its content. |
| [`Column`](./Column.md) | A vertical layout alias for `Stack`. |
| [`Combobox`](./Combobox.md) | A searchable Picker. |
| [`DatePicker`](./DatePicker.md) | A native date, time, or combined picker. |
| [`Detail`](./Detail.md) | A content column with Markdown or composed content and Metadata. |
| [`Dialog`](./Dialog.md) | A form overlay opened through an Action; presented as a sheet on phone. |
| [`EmptyState`](./EmptyState.md) | An icon, title, description, and one action for an empty view. |
| [`Field`](./Field.md) | A labeled wrapper around an input with hint and error content. |
| [`FieldDescription`](./FieldDescription.md) | Hint text associated with a Field. |
| [`FieldErrors`](./FieldErrors.md) | Validation messages associated with a Field. |
| [`FieldLayout`](./FieldLayout.md) | A layout for a field label and its control. |
| [`FilterPill`](./FilterPill.md) | A toggleable filter chip. |
| [`Form`](./Form.md) | A stacked form with a submit action and App-held drafts. |
| [`Grid`](./Grid.md) | Static grid layout; use List for long or virtual grids. |
| [`GroupedList`](./GroupedList.md) | A grouped list container whose item renderer runs in the Plugin worker and expands to keyed child nodes. |
| [`GroupedListItem`](./GroupedListItem.md) | A grouped settings-style row with optional secondary value and named Slots. |
| [`Icon`](./Icon.md) | A native symbol with semantic size, tone, and optional status mark. |
| [`IconButton`](./IconButton.md) | An icon-only button. |
| [`Image`](./Image.md) | An image from a Plugin asset or remote URL, with optional light and dark sources. |
| [`Inspector`](./Inspector.md) | A side pane on wide screens and a Sheet on compact screens. |
| [`Kbd`](./Kbd.md) | A keyboard shortcut key or chord for desktop and web. |
| [`Label`](./Label.md) | Short text with an optional icon and semantic tone. |
| [`Link`](./Link.md) | Text that opens a URL or an Argo route. |
| [`List`](./List.md) | A settings and content list with sections, pagination, refresh, selection, and list or grid layout. Its `empty` Slot shows an `EmptyState` when no items remain. |
| [`ListDetail`](./ListDetail.md) | A list and detail scaffold that splits on wide screens and drills in on compact screens. |
| [`ListItem`](./ListItem.md) | A slotted list row or grid tile with up to three text lines. |
| [`ListSection`](./ListSection.md) | A titled List section with an optional footer. |
| [`Markdown`](./Markdown.md) | Markdown content rendered with Argo typography and link behavior. |
| [`Menu`](./Menu.md) | A menu presented from an ActionList. |
| [`Metadata`](./Metadata.md) | Label and value rows for a detail view. |
| [`Page`](./Page.md) | A page scaffold with a title, header actions, and optional search. |
| [`Picker`](./Picker.md) | A selection control, including multiple and segmented variants. |
| [`Pill`](./Pill.md) | Static short text with a semantic tone or tracker color. |
| [`Popover`](./Popover.md) | A popover overlay opened through an Action. |
| [`ProgressBar`](./ProgressBar.md) | A determinate progress indicator with semantic tone. |
| [`Row`](./Row.md) | A horizontal layout alias for `Stack`. |
| [`ScrollView`](./ScrollView.md) | A scroll container with an Argo-drawn scroll fade. |
| [`SearchField`](./SearchField.md) | Search input for Page headers and Lists. |
| [`Sheet`](./Sheet.md) | A sheet overlay opened through an Action. |
| [`Slider`](./Slider.md) | A labeled numeric range control. |
| [`Spacer`](./Spacer.md) | Flexible space inside a layout. |
| [`Spinner`](./Spinner.md) | An indeterminate progress indicator. |
| [`SplitButton`](./SplitButton.md) | A primary action with a secondary action menu. |
| [`Stack`](./Stack.md) | A row or column layout with token spacing and cross-axis alignment. |
| [`StatusDot`](./StatusDot.md) | A compact semantic status mark with an optional pulse. |
| [`Surface`](./Surface.md) | A semantic surface with fill, radius, depth, and optional press behavior. |
| [`Svg`](./Svg.md) | A sanitized SVG visual with bounded dimensions. |
| [`Switch`](./Switch.md) | A labeled on/off control. |
| [`Table`](./Table.md) | A list-style data container whose item renderer runs in the Plugin worker and expands to keyed child nodes. |
| [`Text`](./Text.md) | Text content with an optional Argo typography role and semantic tone. |
| [`TextInput`](./TextInput.md) | A single-line text input. |
| [`Textarea`](./Textarea.md) | A multi-line text input. |
| [`Toast`](./Toast.md) | A transient status message opened through an Action. |
| [`Tooltip`](./Tooltip.md) | A short description attached to a control. |
| [`Video`](./Video.md) | A stock video player whose source is served through the Server. |
| [`VirtualList`](./VirtualList.md) | A list container whose item renderer runs in the Plugin worker and expands to keyed child nodes. |
